config.legacy: Exact prior numerical behavior, required to reproduce frozen ledger.
config.baseline: Prior rules with shared price-domain tolerance at the 5R trigger; no breakeven.
config.be3: Same baseline plus cost breakeven, first confirmed 15m close at or beyond 3R.
config.be_stop: entry + side * round_trip_cost * entry; round toward profit to the next tick; can only tighten protection.
config.validity: After trigger, apply only at a completed 15m close at least one tick beyond rounded breakeven; otherwise defer until a later valid 15m close.
config.effective: Old stop is tested first. All close-derived stops become effective next 5m bar. No entry-bar wick use.
config.hour_exit: Only after the original 5R trailing activation; 3R breakeven alone does not enable H1 opposite exit.
config.boundary: Reuse original per-entry segment end; no crossing cuts. Keep all independent overlapping entries and matching identities.
config.outputs: Full and chronological segment net R, constant-notional PnL, matched controls and paired policy changes, saved losers, lost 10R/20R outcomes, per-trade differences.
config.limitations: Historical exploratory test, not unseen confirmation; no funding/additional slippage or shared-capital account simulation.
